      • A front row seat to how a network actually gets run in 2026. Open source forwarding, config as code, and an LLM layer doing real operational work. Not a slide about the future of network operations, but the environment you would work in every shift, and help build.

      • Real engineering, not just monitoring. The role is built so the quiet hours go into automation, propagation and health work, and tickets off the board. The path into deeper network engineering and automation work is the plan, not a vague someday.

      • Competitive salary and private health and wellness benefits, fully remote, in a mission driven, investor backed company building the backbone of Africa's next generation internet.

We are hiring a contract-based Senior Shopify Developer to contribute to our Design and Development Team.

Original Job posting link here

 

🌎About garden3d

We are worker owned creative collective, innovating on everything from brands and IRL communities to IoT devices and cross platform apps. We share profit, open source everything, spin out new businesses, and invest in exciting ideas through financial and/or in-kind contributions.

Our client roster includes Google, Stripe, Figma, Hinge, Black Socialists in America, ACLU, Pratt, Parsons, Mozilla, The Nobel Prize, MIT, Gnosis, Etsy & Gagosian.

We’re the software team behind innovative products like The Light Phone & Mill, and we operate a global, decentralized community space collective called Index Space.

We think of our garden3d as collective for creative people, prioritizing a happy, talented, and diverse studio culture. We work on projects that bring value to our world, and we balance deep care for the work we do with a genuine curiosity about life outside of our jobs.

Sanctuary Computer — Development At Sanctuary Computer we’re building a different type of technology shop – one that prioritizes close collaboration between the client and the craftsperson.

Our projects range from design-forward websites, to robust web apps, to native mobile development.

XXIX — Design When we started XXIX in 2013, we set out to create a different kind of design studio and we’ve thrived because we continually ask what a creative practice can be.

We’re building a radically different kind of organization that values autonomy, growth, transparency, and shared responsibility.

Plus, our partner organizations

  • Lightphone
  • Mill
  • IngredientAI

 

🔮 Who we’re looking for:

We're looking for a Senior Shopify Developer who balances deep e-commerce expertise with modern frontend engineering. You'll build pixel-perfect, hyper-performant storefronts ranging from custom Liquid themes to headless Hydrogen/Next.js implementations working alongside our design team to create world-class shopping experiences.

In this role, you’ll work across a variety of client projects to find cost-effective, high-quality, and pragmatic solutions to complex e-commerce challenges. Responsibilities will include:

  • Collaborating closely with Technical Leads and Designers to meet clients' custom e-commerce and technical needs.
  • Building and maintaining high-performance storefronts using both custom Liquid (Online Store 2.0) and modern headless architectures (Shopify Storefront API, GraphQL, Hydrogen/Remix, Next.js).
  • Implementing responsive, accessible, and pixel-perfect interfaces based on design specifications, with meticulous attention to product interaction details and motion design.
  • Integrating custom storefronts with headless CMS platforms (Sanity, Contentful), payment gateways, subscriptions, search, and third-party e-commerce APIs.
  • Optimizing e-commerce performance, focusing heavily on Core Web Vitals, image/video asset delivery, bundle size, and runtime efficiency across high-traffic collection and product pages.
  • Architecting scalable, reusable component libraries and design systems tailored for commercial platforms.
  • Writing clear documentation for store management, custom app integrations, and codebase maintenance.
  • Participating in project team rituals, including Sprint Planning, daily standups, code reviews, and retrospectives.

The person we’re looking for is happy, relaxed and easy to get along with. They’re flexible on anything except conceits that will lower their usually outstanding work quality. They work “smart”, by carefully managing their workflow and staggering features that have dependencies intelligently. They prefer deep work but are OK coming up to the surface now and then for top level / strategic conversations.

We believe people with backgrounds or interests in design, art, music, food or fashion tend to have a well rounded sense of design & quality, so a variety of hobbies or side projects is a big nice to have!

 

🔑 Must-Have Competencies:

We’re always pitching for new and exciting technology niches. Some of the areas below are relevant to us!

  • 8+ years writing highly performant frontend code with an obsession for 95+ Lighthouse scores and optimal Core Web Vitals.
  • Deep Shopify Ecosystem Mastery: Proven experience building custom Shopify themes (Liquid, JSON templates, Online Store 2.0) as well as headless storefronts using the Shopify Storefront API (GraphQL) and frameworks like Hydrogen/Remix or Next.js.
  • Modern Frontend Tech: Expert-level experience with TypeScript and modern CSS methodologies (Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules) alongside robust animation libraries (GSAP, Framer Motion).
  • Headless CMS & Integrations: Extensive experience merging Shopify with headless CMS platforms like Sanity, Contentful, or Prismic, as well as third-party services (Klaviyo, Recharge, Algolia/Searchspring, Stripe).
  • Platform & Hosting: Fluency in industry-standard PaaS platforms including Vercel, Netlify, and Shopify Oxygen.
  • Architecture & State Management: Experience with state management solutions (Zustand, Redux, Pinia) and API integration patterns for cart state, multi-currency, and checkout flows.
  • Quality & Accessibility: Experience building accessible (WCAG compliant), responsive interfaces with a strong commitment to SEO best practices, testing frameworks (Jest, Playwright, Cypress), and maintainable code.
  • Performance Optimization: Practical knowledge of WebSockets, caching strategies (Redis, CDN-level/Cloudflare), and advanced image delivery networks.

 

💪 Nice-to-Have Competencies:

  • Custom App Development: Building bespoke Shopify Apps using Node.js, Remix, GraphQL Admin API, and Shopify CLI.
  • Shopify Plus & Enterprise Features: Hands-on experience with Shopify Functions, Checkout Branding API, Shopify Scripts, and B2B configurations.
  • Tracking & Analytics: Setting up server-side tracking, GTM, Meta Pixel, and Customer Privacy APIs without hurting site load times.
  • WebGL, Canvas & 3D: Experience building interactive graphics, 3D product visualizers, or canvas animations using Three.js or ``.
  • Full-Stack & API Design: Experience across backend/database layers (PostgreSQL), REST/GraphQL API design, and authentication flows (OAuth, JWT).
  • Client-Facing & Management: Direct experience working with clients to clarify requirements, defining product roadmaps, or leading engineering teams.

 

💸 Compensation

Our pay scale ranges from $40/hr to $120/hr pending seniority (& team leadership experience), and our projects are rarely less than 8 full time weeks at 40 hours per week.

We prefer long standing relationships with highly accountable and communicative team members, so we encourage candidates to expect longer term engagements.

 
🎤 How we interview

After you submit your application, a member of our team will reach out. Our interview process starts with an intro call to answer any questions you have about the role and to learn a bit more about your experience and interests.

From there, we’ll follow up with a panel interview call where you get to meet a few members of our team, to openly discuss some of our challenges and ensure your skills and interests align with where we’re going as a business.

For qualified candidates, the process wraps with a reference call, and an offer to follow.

 
👩‍🏭 How we work:

We believe that there’s a better balance between the poles of freelancing & full time, and for that reason Sanctuary works differently to most shops:

  • Transparency & Ownership: We release out Profit & Loss statements to the community each year, open source our best ideas, and talk business & money with everyone in the company. We’re proud to run our business with integrity, and for that reason we share everything with our team & community.
  • 150% Carbon Negative: Our studio offsets 150% of the carbon we use to do business each year, dated back to our founding in 2015. We turn down work that is not in-line with our morals, and we encourage our peers to do the same. We have been certified climate neutral since 2021.
  • Strong Morals: Since our founding, we've turned down somewhere between $1mm - $2mm of work that didn't meet our moral standards. (Most of that was DTC brands that can't show a valid sustainability initiative).
  • Async & Decentralized: We use tools optimized for calm, thoughtful communication, and opt for async whenever possible. We fight hard to maintain our focus time.
  • Remote Friendly: Our company is fluent in remote work, making our workplace more decentralized, and democratized in the process.
  • Ideas & Products: In our spare studio time, we work to build our own open source or internal products to diversify & bolster our income. We create amazing technology products for our clients, so why not for the studio?

→ Read more on our Substack, over here, or our Medium, over there.

 
Important Reminders

Kindly submit a complete and thoughtful application, including relevant links that help verify your work experience and identity. Applications with missing or insufficient information will not move forward in the review process.

Our team carefully reviews every complete submission, and we truly appreciate the time and effort you put into applying! Thank you! :)

Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

The Applied AI team works embedded with Addepar's strategic clients to figure out where AI can change how they work and then build those capabilities from scratch. You'll spend time understanding a client's world, identify what's worth building, prototype it, prove it works, and then partner with core engineering teams to ship it as product for all customers.

As a Staff Applied AI Engineer, you'll set the technical direction for the team's AI work: how we build agents, how we evaluate them, and how we take a capability from client-specific prototype to general product. You'll take the hardest client engagements yourself, defining new problem domains and making high-stakes calls on what's production-ready. You'll also build the patterns and tools that help other engineering teams across Addepar adopt AI effectively. The problems are largely unsolved. The team is new. The right person sees that as the opportunity.

What You'll Do

  • Set the technical direction for AI engineering across the team: agent architecture patterns, evaluation methodology, deployment and monitoring strategies
  • Design the AI platform layer, including the shared agent frameworks, tool integrations, and evaluation infrastructure the team builds on
  • Work directly with clients on the most complex engagements: identifying new problem domains, designing AI capabilities for workflows that have never been automated, and ensuring production quality
  • Make high-judgment calls on AI readiness: deciding what is production-worthy and what is not, balancing speed with reliability in a domain where the stakes are real
  • Drive the handoff from prototype to product, working with core engineering teams to generalize client-specific capabilities for all customers
  • Lead production quality for AI systems: designing observability, establishing SLOs, and building the operational practices that keep AI reliable
  • Mentor and grow AI and full stack engineers, setting the technical and cultural bar for a new team
  • Shape product direction by translating what you learn from client engagements into roadmap priorities

Who You Are

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Professional experience with Python (the team's primary language)
  • Deep experience building and operating AI/LLM-powered systems in production: agent architectures, multi-model orchestration, evaluation at scale
  • Track record of designing technical systems that other engineers build on. You think in platforms and patterns, not individual features
  • Experience with AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Codex, or similar)
  • You've repeatedly taken products or capabilities from zero to one. You're as comfortable identifying the right problem as you are building the right system
  • Experience working directly with customers or external stakeholders to scope and deliver technical work
  • Strong judgment in ambiguous, high-stakes environments. You know when to move fast and when to be careful.
  • Ability to lead technical direction without formal authority. You influence across teams through the quality of your thinking and your work
  • Excellent communication skills. Credible with clients, engineers, and executive leadership
  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Mathematics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent experience

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing multi-service AI platform architectures (model serving, agent orchestration, evaluation infrastructure)
  • Experience with additional backend languages (Java is valuable in our environment)
  • Financial services domain knowledge (portfolios, trading, document management, regulatory workflows)
  • Experience with production observability and SaaS operational excellence at scale
  • Background in developer experience or internal platform work, building tools that change how engineering teams operate

  • Providing training and assistance to field managers and crews in the performance of work-related tasks

  • Assisting Project Managers in evaluating various production rates related to the project

  • Completing all essential paperwork in a clear an accurate manner

  • High school degree or equivalent.

  • Experience in schedule and task management.

Crum & Forster Company Overview

Crum & Forster (C&F), with a proud history dating to 1822, provides specialty and standard commercial lines insurance products through our admitted and surplus lines insurance companies. C&F enjoys a financial strength rating of "A+" (Superior) by AM Best and is proud of our superior customer service platform. Our claims and risk engineering services are recognized as among the best in the industry.

Our most valuable asset is our people: more than 2000 employees in locations throughout the United States. The company is increasingly winning recognition as a great place to work, earning several workplace and wellness awards, including the 2025 Great Place to Work® Award for our employee-first focus and our steadfast commitment to diversity, equity and Inclusion.

C&F is part of Fairfax Financial Holdings, a global, billion dollar organization. For more information about Crum & Forster, please visit our website: www.cfins.com.

Job Description

C&F’s Commercial Lines division delivers specialized insurance solutions for mid-sized and large businesses across a broad range of commercial exposures, management liabilities, and industry segments.

Our portfolio includes tailored coverage solutions for General Liability, Commercial Auto, Workers’ Compensation, Property, and Excess Liability, as well as Financial Lines products such as Management Liability, Professional Liability, Cyber, Crime, and Fidelity.

With more than 700 employees across the United States, Commercial Lines combines deep underwriting expertise, disciplined risk selection, and the strength of C&F’s national platform. We work closely with our customers and distribution partners to provide responsive service, thoughtful risk solutions, and the confidence to navigate complex business challenges.

Crum & Forster is seeking an experienced claims professional to join our dynamic team as an Auto Material Damage Specialist. In this role, you will manage an assigned inventory of claims arising primarily from Personal Lines Auto, Garage keepers Liability, and Commercial Auto Liability policies. You will handle claims within established authority levels and under the appropriate level of supervision. Based on business needs, the position will report to an assigned Manager and Vice President.

This is a remote position, but candidate must be located in Hawaii.

What you will do for C&F:

  • Receives claims assignments, verifies and determines applicability of coverage.
  • Determines the method and extent of investigation for each claim as required by company Best Practices.
  • Reviews and manages outstanding files, as assigned, for adequacy and timeliness of investigation, evaluation and reserve and maintains a timely diary for each case.
  • Evaluates and adjusts claims within the adjuster's authority level.
  • Reports directly on technical matters to supervisor and management.
  • Evaluates and manages auto material damage claims, determines future course of handling and proper method of disposition, including total loss handling. Consults with the claim manager on those claims in which assistance and consultation is needed, as well as on those claims which exceed assigned authority.
  • Assesses recovery potential and is responsible for the development of information required to successfully pursue recovery.
  • Participate in quarterly claim reviews and follow all claim handling requirements for special handling accounts.
  • Accountable for the equitable and prompt adjustment and management of assigned claims to disposition in accordance with Best Practices.
  • Responsible for providing superior customer service to all agents, insureds, and others encountered during the claims handling process.

What you will bring to C&F:

  • Three plus years of experience handling auto material damage claims.
  • A college degree is preferred. Insurance designations or related coursework are a plus.
  • A current Hawaii adjuster license is required.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with employees at all levels of the organization.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
  • Ability to follow departmental policies, procedures, and authority levels in support of C&F’s risk management controls.

What C&F will bring to you

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Generous 401K employer match
  • Employee Stock Purchase plan with employer matching
  • Generous Paid Time Off
  • Excellent benefits that go beyond health, dental & vision. Our programs are focused on your whole family’s wellness, including your physical, mental and financial wellbeing
  • A core C&F tenet is owning your career development, so we provide a wealth of ways for you to keep learning, including tuition reimbursement, industry-related certifications and professional training to keep you progressing on your chosen path
  • A dynamic, ambitious, fun and exciting work environment
  • We believe you do well by doing good and want to encourage a spirit of social and community responsibility, matching donation program, volunteer opportunities, and an employee-driven corporate giving program that lets you participate and support your community

Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

The Role

The Sr. Director, Evergreen Subscription Sales- Strategics & GSI leads the global strategy, vision, and execution of Evergreen subscription sales across the Strategics and GSI segments. This role translates global portfolio direction and company objectives into segment-specific commercial strategies, sales motions, operating models, and performance mechanisms that increase subscription adoption, recurring revenue, pipeline progression, customer value, and commercial effectiveness worldwide.

The Senior Director leads a global Evergreen Subscription Sales organization and establishes the priorities, standards, resources, and operating cadence required to execute consistently across regions. The role partners with the Strategics and GSI segment leadership teams, Regional Sales, Account Executives, alliance and partner leaders, and executive stakeholders across Product, Finance, Customer Success, Marketing, Services, and Operations. The role has broad responsibility and significant operational latitude within the defined segments, while the Global VP retains overall ownership of the Evergreen portfolio strategy and global portfolio direction.

Key Responsibilities

Global Segment Strategy, Vision, and Commercial Leadership

  • Develop the global Evergreen subscription sales strategy, vision, and multi-year roadmap for the Strategics and GSI segments within the context of global portfolio and company objectives.
  • Translate global portfolio direction into integrated segment objectives, priorities, policies, resource plans, sales motions, and operating mechanisms.
  • Establish and own global objectives for subscription adoption, recurring revenue growth, qualified pipeline progression, sales productivity, customer value, retention, and expansion across the two segments.
  • Define global coverage, prioritization, account, and partner strategies that reflect the needs of strategic customers, GSI relationships, regional markets, and field organizations.
  • Participate with executive leadership in strategic planning, business reviews, forecasting, and decisions affecting the company’s commercial position in the Strategics and GSI segments.
  • Make final implementation decisions within delegated authority and ensure operational effectiveness across the global Evergreen Subscription Sales organization and its cross-functional programs.
  • Provide informed input into global portfolio strategy, commercial policy, pricing and packaging discussions, and company-wide methods based on segment performance, customer insight, and market dynamics.

Segment Sales Partnership and Executive Commercial Execution

  • Lead the global Evergreen Subscription Sales overlay for the Strategics and GSI segments, establishing engagement standards and aligning with segment leaders, Regional Sales, and Account Executives on priorities, coverage, and execution.
  • Engage early in the most strategic and complex customer and partner opportunities to shape commercial strategy, subscription adoption, deal structure, and long-term account or ecosystem value.
  • Develop repeatable Evergreen sales plays for strategic accounts and GSI-led motions, and drive consistent adoption across relevant regions and field teams.
  • Coach and challenge segment and field leaders on Evergreen value propositions, customer outcomes, competitive differentiation, executive engagement, and commercial execution.
  • Establish executive-level inspection of global pipeline health, opportunity progression, forecast inputs, adoption, financial performance, and execution risks; drive corrective action where needed.
  • Build trusted relationships with executive customers, GSI partners, alliances, and internal leaders, representing the company in critical negotiations and strategic engagements.
  • Serve as the global voice of Strategics and GSI customer and partner insight, ensuring market feedback informs portfolio evolution, commercial strategy, and operating priorities.

Global Organizational Leadership and Talent Development

  • Lead the global Strategics and GSI Evergreen Subscription Sales organization through subordinate managers, senior leaders, and experienced professionals, as established by the organization design.
  • Set the organization’s structure, priorities, objectives, operating cadence, and performance expectations in alignment with global portfolio and company-wide direction.
  • Build organizational capability through coaching, leadership development, succession planning, workforce planning, and performance management across geographies and segments.
  • Establish a global culture of accountability, commercial excellence, customer focus, inclusion, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Lead the development of new methods, scalable sales capabilities, and global practices that improve Evergreen effectiveness across the two segments and contribute to broader company solutions.
  • Create clarity and momentum through growth, transformation, organizational change, and evolving subscription and commercial models.

Cross-Functional, Segment, and Policy Leadership

  • Partner with Product Management to shape portfolio priorities, commercial readiness, and product or solution responses to Strategics and GSI customer and market requirements.
  • Collaborate with Finance and Operations on global business planning, forecasting, performance management, resource allocation, and budgets with functional or multi-department impact.
  • Work with Customer Success, Services, Marketing, and Sales Operations to optimize the end-to-end customer lifecycle and improve adoption, expansion, and partner outcomes.
  • Influence functional policies, processes, evaluation criteria, enablement, and operating standards that improve commercial effectiveness across the Strategics and GSI segments.
  • Reconcile competing perspectives across segments, regions, functions, customers, and partners and make decisions on sensitive, high-impact matters while preserving relationships and advancing business results.
  • Represent Strategics and GSI priorities, risks, and customer or partner insight in global governance and executive planning forums.

Job Description:

Job Summary


The Knowledge Management (KM) Consultant role will be an integral part of our market leading Knowledge Management and Data Strategy practice groups, leading development and management of our KM offerings and methodologies. Finally, the ideal candidate will have a detailed understanding of matter and client life cycles (and related workflows) within law firms, and knowledge of data and information governance leading practices.


This is a client-facing role, and successful employees will be comfortable interacting directly with client personnel at all levels.


Essential Job Responsibilities


· Develop KM strategies and identify use cases in collaboration with law firm stakeholders.

· Act as the primary contact for client representatives with regard to preparation for, and successful configuration of, KM systems.

· Work with Advisory Practice Lead to develop and continuously improve the overall KM practice, its methodologies, and offerings.

· Develop estimates and project work plans for KM projects and collaborate with designated project managers to ensure projects run according to schedule and costs.

· Serve as subject matter expert and lead consultant on design and

implementation of KM solutions.

· Build business cases (for law firms) for KM solutions and document multi-year roadmaps for implementation that identify dependencies and sequencing.

· Design and implement classification schemas related to experiential data including definitions, data structures, and associated metadata.

· Lead the successful implementation and extension of KM programs at firms.

· Lead the configuration and management of client KM systems through the course of a project.

· Advise on data analysis and mapping activities related to planning for integration of internal client data into KM systems to support client priorities.

· Lead client discussions related to data architectures as they impact an KM Program. This includes offering expertise related to taxonomies and governance best practices.

· Lead and manage data integration and import/export works to ensure content is transferred and validated.

· Organize and lead UAT testing phases on client projects, including development of testing scripts or criteria, and obtain stakeholder signoff.

· Develop release notes, contribute to end user communications, and assist with the development of governance models, procedures, and policies.

· Advise clients with design and configuration of matter profiles and business processes supporting matter profiling, and preservation of system compatibility and consistency.

· Develop productive and strong working relationships with KM solution/product providers to understand product roadmaps and remain abreast of all product updates and new features.

· Drive overall client satisfaction through effective development and communication of client deliverables.

· Effectively manage project resources (Fireman and/or client) to successfully execute work as documented in project forecasts and work schedules.

· Take accountability for client satisfaction and quality and accuracy of project deliverables developed during the course of projects.

· Maintain an up-to-date record with regard to the status of all projects being worked on.

· Participate in regular meetings of the Knowledge Management practice and relevant project teams.

· Liaise with other Fireman & Company personnel as necessary in course of duties. Regularly meet with KM solution/product representatives to conduct knowledge share sessions.


Qualifications


· A background within (or consulting to) a professional services vertical is required; a law firm background is preferred.

· A detailed understanding of leading KM vendors and solutions and their functionality, technical architectures, and product roadmaps. Relevant certifications are a plus.

· A deep understanding of typical use cases for KM software for a variety of business departments within professional services firms, Marketing, BD, DE&I, and Pricing.

· Experience managing multiple and simultaneous projects to successful completion and working with a range of project stakeholders including service providers.

· Oral and written communication skills, with the ability to credibly contextualize messaging for both technical and non-technical audiences. The ability to adjust messaging based on the audience is critical.

· Experience of database design and management, and data processing activities.

· Experience with data profiling, root cause analysis and quality improvement techniques.

· Basic understanding of the critical success criteria for experience management programs and solutions.

· Ability to work in a team environment and flexible approach to working with various groups across the globe.

· Competence to prioritize effectively, meet deadlines and accomplish assigned tasks with minimal supervision.

· Familiarity with document management systems, new matter intake, and/or enterprise search platforms a plus.

· Bachelor's Degree preferred, or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.

· Consulting experience preferred.

Our team members have decades of experience as leaders in the industry, working as attorneys, CIOs, CKOs, and experts in KM, LPM, process improvement, and pricing. We are trusted advisors to the world’s most innovative law firms and corporations, and our mission is to help our clients make substantial, distinctive, and lasting improvements in performance.

Proudly voted a Great Place to Work®, we are a dynamic startup in the CPaaS (Communication Platform as a Service) space that is revolutionizing the way businesses communicate. Our team is made up of 400+ energetic and passionate Unifones who are dedicated to delivering the best possible experience to 5000+ customer-centric companies.

We pride ourselves on our fun and collaborative work environment, where creativity and new ideas are constantly encouraged. As shareholders in the business, we’re so much more than a group of passionate communicators. We are Unifones. Join our team and be a part of something big!

Meet the team!

Our Engineering team is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the systems and technologies that drive Unifonic’s solutions. We work closely with other departments to ensure our products and services meet the needs of our customers. If you are passionate about technology and are excited about working on cutting-edge communication and engagement solutions, we want you on our team.

As a Product Manager, Data & Insights, you will lead the development of both customer-facing dashboards and internal reporting systems. This role sits at the intersection of product management, data engineering, and analytics, responsible for delivering intuitive, reliable, and scalable reporting experiences for both external users and internal stakeholders.

You will own the end-to-end product lifecycle for reporting capabilities—from customer research and data modeling through to delivery, governance, and continuous improvement. You will partner closely with data engineers, analysts, UX teams, and business stakeholders to build a robust data ecosystem that enables self-service analytics, supports compliance requirements, and delivers meaningful insights for executive decision-making.

You will also champion and lead data compliance initiatives across all Unifonic products, ensuring that data is managed responsibly, securely, and in alignment with organizational and regulatory requirements.

Help us shape the future of communication by:

  • Defining and executing the roadmap for customer-facing analytics, reporting portals, and internal reporting infrastructure. Align reporting solutions with business goals and customer needs. Collaborate with leadership to prioritize initiatives based on impact, complexity, and business value. Be an advisor for other Product teams in data strategy and design.

  • Collecting business and technical requirements from cross-functional stakeholders, including Finance, Operations, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering.

  • Developing detailed feature requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and data contracts for reporting systems. Translate ambiguous business questions into well-defined reporting needs and KPIs.

  • Partnering closely with data engineers to co-develop data models and data marts in the data warehouse (e.g., Snowflake, Qlik, Vertica). Understand schema design and how it impacts performance, usability, and extensibility of data reporting systems. Influence architectural decisions around extract-transform-load (ETL/ELT) processes and dimensional modeling.

  • Owning and enforcing data governance standards, including data definitions, taxonomy, lineage, and version control.

  • Defining processes for data quality verification and anomaly detection in collaboration with engineering and analytics teams. Be an advocate for data accuracy and a watchdog for misleading or incomplete insights.

  • Owning the product experience and lifecycle for reporting and BI platforms (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Sigma, or Mode).

  • Defining self-service analytics capabilities for internal teams. Create feedback loops to continually improve dashboard usability and relevance for both internal and external users.

  • Acting as the bridge between technical and non-technical teams, translating business needs into technical requirements and vice versa. Present product updates, reporting insights, and metrics to executives and cross-functional teams. Facilitate decision-making on trade-offs related to data availability, accuracy, and reporting timelines.

Requirements

What you’ll bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in product management, data, analytics, or reporting platforms, with a strong focus on data-driven products.

  • Proven experience delivering customer-facing reporting products, dashboards, and internal analytics solutions.

  • Strong understanding of data privacy, governance, and compliance frameworks, including GDPR and PDPL.

  • Experience working cross-functionally with data engineers, analysts, product teams, UX, and business stakeholders.

  • Hands-on experience with data warehouses such as ClickHouse, Vertica, or Snowflake, and BI tools such as Metabase, Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or Sigma.

  • Strong SQL skills and a solid understanding of data modeling concepts, including fact and dimension tables and star schemas.

  • Familiarity with ELT pipelines, dbt, and data orchestration tools is a plus.

  • Understanding of data quality, data integrity, scalability, and performance considerations when building reporting solutions.

  • Ability to define business KPIs and translate business and reporting needs into clear data and product requirements.

  • Experience contributing to data governance, data integrity, and compliance initiatives.

  • Ability to balance performance, usability, scalability, and cost when designing data and reporting solutions.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex data concepts into clear business requirements and insights.

  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional discussions, align stakeholders around data strategy, and communicate reporting goals and insights effectively.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Business, Engineering, or a related field

AI Proficiency:

  • Minimum Level:L4 (Proficient). Applies AI across product discovery, specification, prototyping, and stakeholder communication.

  • Expected: Uses AI to speed up research, specs, and prototyping, and personally owns the accuracy of every output.

  • Hands-on experience with Claude and Lovable. Writes structured prompts (role, context, constraints, format) and refines the prompt rather than patching outputs by hand.

  • Synthesizes interviews, tickets, and reviews into themes and testable insights, and validates every insight against source data before sharing.

  • Drafts PRDs, user stories, and executive updates with AI as a first-draft partner, then verifies every claim and number before it reaches leadership.

  • Builds clickable prototypes in Lovable to validate ideas with stakeholders, and is clear that a prototype is not production-ready.

  • Understands how AI agents are built (prompts, tools, memory, guardrails) and proactively identifies workflows worth automating.

  • Flags AI risks (hallucination, bias, data privacy, over-reliance) and knows what should and shouldn't be AI-assisted.

Craft and Toolkit:

  • Strong SQL and data analysis skills.

  • Experience with data warehouses such as Snowflake, ClickHouse, or Vertica.

  • Knowledge of data modeling, dimensional modeling, data marts, and data pipelines.

  • Experience with BI and reporting tools such as Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Sigma, or Metabase.

  • Understanding of ETL/ELT, dbt, and data orchestration.

  • Knowledge of data governance, quality, lineage, and compliance.

  • Understanding of GDPR, PDPL, and data privacy principles.

  • Ability to define KPIs, data requirements, data contracts, and reporting specifications.

  • Understanding of scalable, performant, and cost-effective reporting architectures.

Character Traits:

  • Analytical thinking and problem-solving – approach problems clearly, use data, and find solutions.

  • Ownership and accountability – take responsibility and follow projects through to completion.

  • Communication – explain ideas clearly and listen to others across teams.

  • Collaboration – work well with others and support team goals.

  • Adaptability and learning – adjust to change and keep learning new skills or tools.

  • Mentorship and knowledge sharing – help others grow and share what you know.

  • Resilience – stay calm under pressure and handle setbacks constructively.

  • Quality and attention to detail – do work carefully and strive for improvement.

  • Advocacy and innovation – encourage best practices, efficiency, and new ideas

As a Unifone you’ll receive a range of benefits:

  • Competitive salary and bonus

  • Unifonic share scheme (we are all owners!)

  • 30 holiday days after the first anniversary

  • Your Birthday off!

  • Spend up to 25 days per year working from anywhere in the world!

  • Paid leave for new parents

Job Title:

Digital Analytics Technical Consultant – Developer

Job Description

We're Concentrix. The intelligent transformation partner. Solution-focused. Tech-powered. Intelligence-fueled.

The global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. With unique data and insights, deep industry expertise, and advanced technology solutions, we’re the intelligent transformation partner that powers a world that works, helping companies become refreshingly simple to work, interact, and transact with. We shape new game-changing careers in over 70 countries, attracting the best talent.

The Concentrix Technical Products and Services team is the driving force behind Concentrix’s transformation, data, and technology services. We integrate world-class digital engineering, creativity, and a deep understanding of human behavior to find and unlock value through tech-powered and intelligence-fueled experiences. We combine human-centered design, powerful data, and strong tech to accelerate transformation at scale. You will be surrounded by the best in the world providing market leading technology and insights to modernize and simplify the customer experience. Within our professional services team, you will deliver strategic consulting, design, advisory services, market research, and contact center analytics that deliver insights to improve outcomes and value for our clients. Hence achieving our vision.

Our game-changers around the world have devoted their careers to ensuring every relationship is exceptional. And we’re proud to be recognized with awards such as "World's Best Workplaces," “Best Companies for Career Growth,” and “Best Company Culture,” year after year.

Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.

Role Overview

The Digital Analytics Developer & Analyst is a hands-on technical and client-facing role responsible for designing, implementing, testing, and maintaining measurement solutions across web and mobile experiences. This role ensures accurate, reliable data collection that supports marketing effectiveness, customer journey optimization, experimentation, personalization, and business decision-making.

The ideal candidate combines strong front-end development and analytics implementation skills with the confidence to lead client conversations. They can translate complex technical concepts, risks, and recommendations into clear executive-level messages focused on business impact and next steps.

Responsibilities

  • Translate business requirements into technical tracking specifications, data layer requirements, tagging designs, and acceptance criteria.
  • Develop and maintain analytics implementations using Adobe Data Collection, Adobe Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4, and Adobe Customer Journey Analytics.
  • Write and troubleshoot custom JavaScript to capture page views, user interactions, forms, navigation, ecommerce activity, media engagement, and other customer behaviors.
  • Use HTML, CSS, Regular Expressions, DOM traversal, and DOM scraping to identify, capture, transform, and validate digital experience data.
  • Design and maintain scalable data layers across websites, single-page applications, and mobile experiences.
  • Partner with developers and architects to integrate measurement requirements into application code and release processes.
  • Test and debug analytics implementations using browser developer tools, network requests, console logging, tag debuggers, and platform-specific validation tools.
  • Identify and resolve issues such as missing values, duplicate events, race conditions, selector changes, malformed requests, and inconsistent data.
  • Support integrations with experimentation, personalization, consent management, and customer data platforms.
  • Create and maintain data dictionaries, tracking specifications, implementation guides, test plans, release notes, and technical documentation.
  • Build reports and visualizations using Adobe Analysis Workspace, Adobe CJA, Looker Studio, Power BI, or similar tools.
  • Own analytics implementation projects from discovery and solution design through development, testing, deployment, and post-launch validation.
  • Lead client discovery sessions, technical reviews, solution walkthroughs, and implementation readouts.
  • Translate technical architecture, data-quality issues, dependencies, and tradeoffs into concise executive-level recommendations.
  • Clearly communicate business impact, delivery risks, priorities, and next steps to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Promote reusable development patterns, implementation standards, governance, and opportunities to automate quality assurance.

Required Qualifications

  • 5 or more years of hands-on digital analytics development and implementation experience.
  • Strong experience with Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics 4, Adobe Data Collection, and Google Tag Manager.
  • Proficiency in JavaScript, including event handling, DOM traversal, data transformation, asynchronous execution, browser storage, and debugging.
  • Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, jQuery, Regular Expressions, JSON, APIs, cookies, and browser behavior.
  • Experience with DOM inspection, DOM scraping, CSS selectors, and browser developer tools.
  • Experience designing and maintaining data layers for websites, single-page applications, or mobile experiences.
  • Ability to test analytics implementations across browsers, devices, environments, and release cycles.
  • Experience creating technical specifications, data dictionaries, test plans, and implementation documentation.
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments using Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.
  • Demonstrated experience working directly with clients and senior business stakeholders.
  • Strong presentation and executive communication skills, with the ability to convert technical details into clear business implications and recommendations.
  • Confidence leading client meetings, technical discovery sessions, and executive-level readouts.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience implementing Adobe Customer Journey Analytics.
  • Adobe Analytics, Adobe CJA, or Adobe Experience Platform certification.
  • Experience with Adobe Target, Optimizely, Adobe Real-Time CDP, Tealium, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with mobile analytics and SDK implementations.
  • Familiarity with consent management platforms, Git, automated testing, SQL, and Python.
  • Familiarity with React, Angular, Vue, or other modern JavaScript frameworks.
  • Experience in a consulting, agency, professional services, or enterprise client environment.

Key Skills and Behaviors

  • Strong technical problem-solving and attention to detail
  • Confident client and executive presence
  • Ability to simplify complex technical concepts
  • Consultative, outcome-focused mindset
  • Clear written and verbal communication
  • Strong ownership and accountability
  • Effective collaboration across technical and business teams
  • Ability to identify ambiguity and clarify requirements
  • Sound judgment when balancing technical quality, business priorities, and delivery constraints
  • Commitment to standardization, automation, and continuous improvement

Success in This Role

Success means delivering scalable and maintainable analytics solutions, improving confidence in digital data, identifying implementation risks early, and enabling clients and executives to make informed decisions. This individual will be viewed as both a strong analytics developer and a trusted technical advisor.

      <title>Samsara: Staff Software Engineer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://www.samsara.com/">https://www.samsara.com/</a>
</p>

<p><strong>About the role:</strong></p>
<p>Samsara (NYSE: IOT) sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world. The platform processes 25+ trillion data points annually from IoT sensors, cameras, and connected devices across thousands of organizations, and that dataset is compounding: it grew from 4 trillion to 25+ trillion in four years. We're still early in turning that data into the products that will define how physical operations run, and we're hiring the engineers who will build what comes next.</p>
<p>We're approaching ~$2B ARR growing 30%+ year over year, with 96% of our largest customers on two or more products. The fastest-growing divisions at Samsara are tackling the hardest, most ambiguous problems at the company: building new products from scratch, applying AI and ML to massive real-world datasets, and shipping capabilities that change how organizations maintain equipment, manage fleets, and run day-to-day operations. Most of this work is zero-to-one, at billion-dollar scale.</p>
<p>We're looking for software engineers who want to define what ships next. Leveling is broad and flexible: we're hiring from Senior through Staff+, across platform and product, and we're open to shaping scope around the right person's strengths and interests. That window won't stay open long.</p>
<p><strong>This role is remote and open to candidates residing in the US. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.</strong></p>
<p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>You want to impact the industries that run our world.</strong>&nbsp;The software you build will have real-world stakes: helping keep the lights on, getting food into grocery stores, keeping workers safe. What ships here isn't metrics on a dashboard. It shows up on the loading dock, the job site, and the dispatch floor.</li>
<li><strong>You want to build, not maintain.</strong>&nbsp;Samsara is in full growth mode. We're building new systems from scratch, not babysitting old ones. You'd own entire problem spaces end to end, with the autonomy to set direction from day one.</li>
<li><strong>You want to work where AI meets the physical world.</strong>&nbsp;Samsara has spent a decade building the largest proprietary dataset for physical operations. More connected assets generate more data, more data trains better models, better models drive more value, and more value wins more assets. The market and the opportunity here are what set us apart, not just the models.</li>
<li><strong>You believe customers are more than a number.</strong>&nbsp;Samsara engineers have a rare closeness to end users. You'll participate in customer interviews, collaborate with product managers and customer success, and use that context to build products that solve real problems operators face every day.</li>
<li><strong>You have the curiosity and drive to figure it out.</strong>&nbsp;We're looking for people who take pride in their work and get things done at all costs. The engineers who thrive here don't wait to be told what to build. They define it, ship it, and own the outcome. The rate-limiting step on our teams isn't tooling or process. It's ambition.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>In this role, you will:</strong>&nbsp;</p>
<ul>
<li>Take ownership of technically complex, mission-critical areas and run with them. We want to point you in a direction and show up to the demo meeting impressed, not spend our weeks managing the details.</li>
<li>Define and drive technical strategy for new products and platform capabilities, from backend services and APIs to the customer-facing UI.</li>
<li>Design and ship full-stack features end to end. You'll work across backend, frontend, and potentially mobile to deliver AI-powered products that solve real operational problems.</li>
<li>Partner with product, design, and customer-facing teams to translate ambiguous, real-world problems into clear technical plans and measurable outcomes.</li>
<li>Build and scale the systems behind AI-driven products, including data ingestion, APIs, and the workflows that put intelligence into the hands of operators.</li>
<li>Raise the bar for the engineers around you through code reviews, design reviews, technical mentorship, and by setting a standard for quality, velocity, and craft.</li>
<li>Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Minimum requirements for the role:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.</li>
<li>8+ years of experience in software design and development, including building and operating production systems at scale.</li>
<li>Strong full-stack fundamentals. You're comfortable working across backend services, APIs, and frontend (web or mobile) to ship complete products.</li>
<li>Proficiency in modern languages and frameworks (Go, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, React, or similar).</li>
<li>Demonstrated experience leading cross-team or cross-org projects from inception through rollout, including managing ambiguity, driving alignment, and delivering measurable impact.</li>
<li>Experience building AI-powered or data-driven products. You don't need to train models, but you know how to take AI capabilities and turn them into products customers love.</li>
<li>Strong communication skills and the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders.</li>
<li>A track record of building: zero-to-one products, systems you left in a meaningfully better place, or hard problems you refused to let stay unsolved.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>An ideal candidate also has:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Experience shipping AI-powered features in production, whether that's LLM-based products, agentic workflows, recommendation systems, or other customer-facing AI.</li>
<li>Comfort with modern AI-augmented development workflows (Cursor, LLMs, etc.) to multiply your output and accelerate delivery.</li>
<li>Background working with real-world operational data (telematics, sensor data, work orders, inspections) or a strong interest in learning the domain.</li>
<li>A proven track record of mentoring senior engineers and influencing engineering culture, standards, and best practices beyond a single team.</li>
<li>Side projects, open-source contributions, or other signals of curiosity and drive outside the scope of your day job.</li>
</ul>

<li>Smart and gets things done</li>

<p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Pinterest:</strong></p>
<p>Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.</p>
<p>Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the&nbsp;<a href="https://www.pinterestcareers.com/our-life/pinflex/">flexibility</a> to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.</p>
<p>At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.</p>
<p>Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process <a href="https://www.pinterestcareers.com/our-philosophy-on-ai-in-hiring/">here</a>.</p></div><p>Pinterest brings millions of people the inspiration to create a life they love. Behind that experience is a complex infrastructure ecosystem that powers reliability, performance, measurement, and efficiency across the platform. As Pinterest grows, it’s increasingly important that we understand these systems clearly so we can make smarter decisions for both Pinners and the business.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>We’re looking for a Data Scientist to join our Infrastructure Data Science team. In this role, you’ll partner with engineering and cross-functional teams to make Pinterest’s infrastructure more measurable, intelligible, and actionable. Depending on the area, your work may span app performance, shopping infrastructure, metrics quality, infrastructure governance, or site reliability. You’ll help build the data foundations, measurement systems, and analytical frameworks that enable Pinterest to optimize core technical systems and make better product and infrastructure decisions.<br><br></p>
<p><strong>What you’ll do:</strong></p>
<p>In this role, you will partner closely with engineering and cross-functional teams to improve how Pinterest measures, understands, and optimizes its infrastructure:</p>
<ul>
<li>Partner with engineering teams to define, measure, and improve the health, quality, and efficiency of Pinterest’s infrastructure systems.</li>
<li>Build and refine metrics, dashboards, and analytical frameworks that make complex technical systems more understandable and actionable.</li>
<li>Strengthen data foundations by improving metric definitions, auditing data quality, and contributing to pipeline and measurement improvements where needed.</li>
<li>Design and analyze experiments, investigations, and deep dives to quantify the impact of infrastructure changes on user experience, reliability, and business outcomes.</li>
<li>Translate ambiguous technical problems into clear analyses and actionable recommendations for engineering and platform partners.</li>
<li>Support high-priority investigations and decision-making related to infrastructure performance, reliability, cost, and measurement quality.</li>
<li>Identify opportunities to improve how Pinterest measures and optimizes infrastructure across a range of domains, such as performance, shopping infrastructure, governance, metrics quality, and site reliability.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What we’re looking for:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Masters degree in a relevant field such as Statistics, Applied Math, Biostatistics, or equivalent experience.</li>
<li>Strong SQL and analytical programming skills, with experience working through messy, imperfect data and building reliable metrics and datasets.</li>
<li>Experience partnering on or contributing to production-ready data pipelines, measurement systems, or foundational data work that improves data quality and usability.</li>
<li>Solid foundation in experimentation and measurement, with the ability to design analyses, interpret results rigorously, and partner effectively with engineers and other cross-functional stakeholders.</li>
<li>Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous problems into clear analytical workstreams and actionable recommendations.</li>
<li>Strong cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to explain technical findings clearly to engineering, product, and platform stakeholders.</li>
<li>Ability to operate independently, prioritize across both longer-term projects and fast-turn inbound requests, and drive work forward in a dynamic environment.</li>
<li>Curiosity and a builder mindset, with excitement for improving messy systems and creating more scalable, trustworthy measurement foundations.</li>
</ul>

<p>Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.</p></div><h2>What's the opportunity?&nbsp;</h2>

<p><span>#LI-Hybrid</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Unleash Your Potential</strong></p>
<p>When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.</p>
<p>In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.       <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States, Remote
</p>

<p><strong>Job Title: Commercial Account Manager</strong></p>
<p><strong>Location: United States - Remote</strong></p>
<p>This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.</p>
<p><strong>THE OPPORTUNITY:</strong></p>
<p>At Salesloft, our Commercial Account Managers are pivotal to our company's success. You will be a key member of our fast-growing and high-performing sales team and will be our boots-on-the-ground solution to building personal relationships and making our customers successful. We believe that the most successful sellers have a passionate and supportive team behind them.</p>
<p>On a day-to-day basis, you will be responsible for:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Full-Cycle Account Ownership:</strong> Serving as the primary point of contact and ultimate owner of the account relationship, managing all commercial transactions including upsells, cross-sells, and the end-to-end renewal process.</li>
<li><strong>Driving Net-New Revenue:</strong> Actively prospecting within your assigned territory to identify, qualify, and close new ACV opportunities within your install base to expand your total book of business. Actively hunt for opportunities to introduce additional products or seat expansions to existing customers, maximizing the lifetime value (LTV) of your portfolio.</li>
<li><strong>Account Planning:</strong> Developing and executing success plans for high-value accounts to ensure long-term alignment between their business goals and our solutions.</li>
<li><strong>Proactive Retention Management:</strong> Monitoring account health and usage patterns to identify potential churn risks early, implementing "save" strategies to protect existing recurring revenue.</li>
<li><strong>Executive Relationship Building:</strong> Cultivating ties with VPs, C-suite executives and key stakeholders to move beyond a vendor relationship and become a trusted business advisor.</li>
<li><strong>Forecasting &amp; Pipeline Accuracy:</strong> Provide leadership with accurate monthly, and quarterly revenue forecasts for both net new bookings and churn.</li>
<li><strong>Market &amp; Competitive Intelligence:</strong> Staying up to date of industry trends and competitor movements to effectively position our value proposition against market alternatives.</li>
<li><strong>Collaborative Problem Solving:</strong> Partnering with Customer Success, Product, and Support teams to resolve complex client issues and ensure seamless post-sale transitions.</li>
<li><strong>Segmented Renewal Strategy:</strong> Partnering with Renewal Account Managers to streamline the execution of long-tail, lower-spend accounts, while simultaneously identifying and "cherry-picking" growth potential within that book to migrate into higher-value tiers.</li>
</ul>
<p>In addition to working with amazing colleagues who live our core values every day, you will also have the opportunity to sell an impactful and revolutionary software that is changing the way sellers sell. You will have an opportunity to make a difference.</p>
<p><strong>WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:</strong></p>
<p>We are seeking a results-oriented, motivated, and strategic Commercial Account Manager. You are a growth-minded advocate who is laser-focused on deepening and expanding relationships within our existing customer base. You don't just manage accounts; you hunt for untapped potential, identifying new use cases and scaling our footprint across organizations.</p>
<p>Specifically, you will play a pivotal role in helping us become an anchor technology company by securing high-value renewals and winning expansion deals that propel you past your quota.</p>
<p>If you're passionate about sales technology, obsessed with delivering a world-class customer experience, and thrive in a fast-paced, hyper-growth startup environment, then this is the career path for you!</p>
<p><strong>THE TEAM:</strong></p>
<p>Our Salesloft Commercial Sales team is comprised of motivated sales professionals with a strong desire to win.</p>
<p>Values: Move as One, Evidence over Ego, Lead from the Front, Make Your Mark, Customer-Inspired.</p>
<p>The Commercial Account Management team consists of results-oriented SaaS sales professionals with a strong desire to win. The Account Managers on our team share a few common traits: they are self-motivated, ambitious, and passionate about evangelizing the future of sales innovation.</p>
<p><strong>THE SKILL SET:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>2-3 years of proven relationship building &amp; closing experience in a SaaS environment</li>
<li>Experience establishing strategic C-level relationships</li>
<li>Ability to run a full sales lifecycle, start to finish, within the SMB segment</li>
<li>Experience executing detailed product presentations and web demonstrations of our software capabilities to C-level executives, directors, and sales managers</li>
<li>Adept at identifying and utilizing internal resources (Sales Engineers, Customer Success, Support etc.) to build Salesloft brand awareness, assist in sales cycles, and close deals.</li>
<li>Collaborative mentality by prioritizing 'we' and not focusing on 'me.'</li>
<li>Superb listening skills; you must understand objections and defeat them by turning skeptics into ecstatic new customers</li>
<li>High level of empathy - it's important for our AM's to be a good person to peers and prospects.</li>
<li>Experience managing, expanding, and renewing customer relationships.</li>
<li>Consistent overachievement of quota and revenue goals.</li>
<li>Proven ability to make strong connections and overcome rejection to achieve results.</li>
<li>Demonstrated ability to conduct compelling on-site and virtual presentations to C-Level executives.</li>
</ul>
<p>At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.</p>
<p>We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.</p>
<p>If you're excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us!</p>
<p>#LI-Remote</p>
<p>Please note that all official communication regarding job opportunities at Salesloft will come from an @salesloft.com email address. If you receive messages on LinkedIn or other job platforms claiming to be from Salesloft, they may not be legitimate. To verify the authenticity of any job-related communication, please visit our official Careers Page (<a href="https://salesloft.com/company/careers/">https://salesloft.com/company/careers/</a>).</p>
<p>We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, notetaking, or summarizing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment — all hiring decisions are made by people. If you would like more information about how your data is processed or prefer to opt out of any AI-assisted tools, please let your recruiter know. Opting out will not impact your experience or consideration.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>It is Salesloft’s intent to pay all Lofters competitive wages and salaries that are motivational, fair and equitable.&nbsp; The goal of Salesloft’s compensation program is to be transparent, attract potential employees, meet the needs of all current employees and encourage employees to stay with our organization.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p>Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location.</p>
<p>The total compensation package for this position may also include performance bonus, benefits and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans.&nbsp;</p></div><div class="title">Base Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$50,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$65,000 USD</span></div></div></div>
